dict.string: Double jump to get over the red hurdles.
Try jumping over one hurdle, then double jumping to get over the next hurdle.
Try sprinting through the sand pits.
Try double jumping early to get over the pigs.
Press the action button to kick the chickens.
Kicked chickens are the best way to defeat cows.
Don't double-jump when you see a crow.
You can jump again in the air. This will help you get over hurdles.
The battery shows how much health you have left.
